subject: paediatrics
title: Infantile cholestasis: biliary atresia versus neonatal hepatitis

steps.tx: Infantile **cholestasis** means conjugated bilirubin above the stated threshold with pale stools and dark urine in a young baby. A firm enlarged liver and poor growth complete the bedside picture that demands urgent sorting in clinic. **Biliary atresia** progressively obliterates extrahepatic ducts, while neonatal hepatitis inflames liver cells with giant cell change under the microscope. Ultrasound looks for a triangular cord sign and an absent gallbladder, and liver biopsy shows duct proliferation with bile plugs. Stool colour cards screen babies early at home.
steps.say: Infantile cholestasis means conjugated bilirubin rises with pale stools and dark urine in a young baby presenting late. A firm enlarged liver and poor growth complete the bedside picture that demands urgent sorting in paediatric clinic referrals. One surgical disease progressively obliterates ducts while hepatitis inflames liver cells with giant cell change under the microscope seen. Ultrasound looks for a cord sign and absent gallbladder while biopsy shows duct proliferation with bile plugs inside tissue. Stool colour cards are screening tools that identify babies early and families bring photographs to every review appointment in clinic practice now.

steps.tx: The **Kasai portoenterostomy** connects jejunum directly to the porta hepatis and works best **before 60 days** of age. Surgeons excise the fibrotic extrahepatic remnant and sew a Roux loop onto tiny patent ductules at the hilum carefully. Clearing of jaundice after surgery predicts native liver survival, while failed drainage leads toward transplant assessment in specialist centres. Fever with acholic stools after surgery signals cholangitis and needs prompt intravenous antibiotics without any delay at all. Choledochal cysts need complete excision because retained cysts carry pancreatitis and malignancy risk.
steps.say: One operation is designed to connect jejunum directly to the liver hilum and works best very early in infancy before fibrosis advances irreversibly. Surgeons excise the fibrotic remnant and sew a bowel loop onto tiny patent ductules at the hilum carefully during surgery. Clearing of jaundice predicts native liver survival while failed drainage leads toward transplant assessment in specialist centres for infants affected. Fever with pale stools after surgery signals ascending infection and needs prompt intravenous antibiotics without any delay at all whatsoever. Cystic dilatations need complete excision because retained tissue carries pancreatitis and malignancy risk into adult life ahead.

steps.tx: This surgical illustration shows a **Kasai portoenterostomy** with a jejunal **Roux en Y** loop sutured directly to the porta hepatis. The fibrotic extrahepatic remnant sits excised to one side, while tiny patent microscopic ductules drain bile into the bowel loop. The timing label stresses surgery before sixty days, because later fibrosis closes those ductules and drainage fails completely afterwards. Clearing jaundice after this anastomosis predicts native liver survival, and failure moves the child toward transplant assessment. Fever with pale stools later means cholangitis until proven otherwise.

Tiny patent microscopic ductules drain bile into the bowel loop because the normal extrahepatic pathway has obliterated progressively before surgery performed. The timing label stresses very early surgery because later fibrosis closes those ductules and drainage fails completely afterwards without intervention done. Clearing jaundice predicts native liver survival while failure moves the child toward transplant assessment in specialist centres for care. Fever with pale stools later means ascending infection until teams prove otherwise with cultures and imaging studies done.

steps.tx: Treatable medical causes hide inside cholestasis and clinicians must exclude each one systematically during workup. Milk removal treats **galactosaemia**, nitisinone treats tyrosinaemia, and thyroxine treats hypothyroid infants whose jaundice prolongs without treatment given. Alpha 1 antitrypsin deficiency with the severe phenotype injures liver and lung across childhood and adult life together. **Alagille syndrome** combines bile duct paucity with butterfly vertebrae, cardiac disease and characteristic facies in affected children followed long term. Genetic counselling follows every syndromic diagnosis for the family.
steps.say: Treatable medical causes hide inside cholestasis and clinicians must exclude each one systematically during the diagnostic workup of infants. Milk removal treats one metabolic disease while another drug treats tyrosinaemia and thyroxine treats hypothyroid infants whose jaundice prolongs untreated. One enzyme deficiency injures liver and lung across childhood and adult life together in severely affected patients followed longitudinally in clinics. A syndromic disease combines duct paucity with vertebral, cardiac and facial features in affected children followed long term by teams. Genetic counselling follows every syndromic diagnosis because recurrence risk shapes future pregnancies for the family involved deeply today.

steps.tx: Supportive care sustains growth while the liver disease declares its course over months of follow up. **Medium chain triglyceride** formulas bypass bile dependent fat absorption and deliver calories that infants actually absorb well daily. Teams monitor fat soluble **vitamins A, D, E and K** because deficiency bleeds, softens bones and injures nerves without replacement therapy. Vaccination, variceal surveillance and ascites treatment with diuretics complete hepatology follow up in specialist clinics for referred children. Stool diaries and early transplant referral keep families ahead of decompensation events.

Special formulas bypass bile dependent fat absorption and deliver calories that infants actually absorb well every day at home feeds. Teams monitor fat soluble vitamins because deficiency bleeds, softens bones and injures nerves without replacement therapy given regularly by mouth daily. Vaccination and ascites treatment complete follow up while stool diaries keep families ahead of decompensation events at home between visits. Early transplant referral protects children whose native liver fails despite surgery and nutrition support over time ahead now.
